title: OSS Awarded $2.75 Million Contract by U.S. Army to Develop Next-Generation Compute Appliance for Tactical Ground Vehicles
summary: Strengthens OSS’s role in developing the U.S. Army’s next-generation tactical ground vehicle compute architecture Advanced compute system designed to support operational C5ISR integration and distribution Development award may provide opportunities for future production programs across multiple U.S. Army and allied vehicle platforms ESCONDIDO, Calif. – November 9, 2026 – One Stop Systems, Inc. (OSS or the Company) (Nasdaq: OSS), a leader in rugged Enterprise Class compute for artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML) and sensor processing at the edge, today announced it has been awarded a $2.75 million contract by the U.S. Army to develop a next-generation compute appliance for tactical ground vehicles. This award reflects OSS’s multi-year efforts to integrate high-performance technology into the compute architecture of the Army’s tactical ground vehicles. OSS currently anticipates delivering working systems to the Army during the second half of 2027. Under the contract, OSS’s engineering team will work with the Army to develop a Sensor Open Systems Architecture (SOSA) aligned compute system in support of the U.S. Army’s near-term ground vehicle program office requirements. The latest award builds upon OSS’s ongoing work with the Army in developing its next-generation tactical ground vehicle compute architecture. It also extends OSS’s rugged AI compute technology into new mission critical defense applications, an increasingly critical priority for the U.S. Department of War. OSS believes the SOSA-aligned architecture may support potential applications across multiple U.S. Army and allied military vehicle platforms. “We are pleased to continue supporting the Army as it brings high-performance technology into the compute architecture of its tactical ground vehicles,” said Mike Knowles, President and CEO of OSS. “We believe this award reflects the strength of our rugged compute and sensor processing platforms and our ability to address the Army’s evolving requirements. Our experience across multiple defense and commercial programs demonstrates the potential for initial development awards to lead to meaningful production opportunities. We believe our early involvement in this program positions OSS to compete for follow-on orders as the program matures. It also furthers our strategy of taking our Enterprise Class compute deeper into next-generation defense programs.” About One Stop SystemsOne Stop Systems, Inc. (Nasdaq: OSS) is a leader in AI enabled solutions for the demanding 'edge'. OSS designs and manufactures Enterprise Class compute and storage products that enable rugged AI, sensor fusion and autonomous capabilities without compromise. These hardware and software platforms bring the latest data center performance to harsh and challenging applications, whether they are on land, sea or in the air. OSS products include ruggedized servers, compute accelerators, flash storage arrays, and storage acceleration software. These specialized compact products are used across multiple industries and applications, including autonomous trucking and farming, as well as aircraft, drones, ships and vehicles within the defense industry. OSS solutions address the overall AI workflow, from high-speed data acquisition to deep learning, training and large-scale inference, and have delivered many industry firsts for industrial OEM and government customers. **ESCONDIDO, Calif. – November 9, 2026 –** One Stop Systems, Inc. (OSS or the Company) (Nasdaq: OSS), a leader in rugged Enterprise Class compute for artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML) and sensor processing at the edge, today announced it has been awarded a $2.75 million contract by the U.S. Army to develop a next-generation compute appliance for tactical ground vehicles. This award reflects OSS’s multi-year efforts to integrate high-performance technology into the compute architecture of the Army’s tactical ground vehicles. OSS currently anticipates delivering working systems to the Army during the second half of 2027.


****


Under the contract, OSS’s engineering team will work with the Army to develop a Sensor Open Systems Architecture (SOSA) aligned compute system in support of the U.S. Army’s near-term ground vehicle program office requirements.


The latest award builds upon OSS’s ongoing work with the Army in developing its next-generation tactical ground vehicle compute architecture. It also extends OSS’s rugged AI compute technology into new mission critical defense applications, an increasingly critical priority for the U.S. Department of War. OSS believes the SOSA-aligned architecture may support potential applications across multiple U.S. Army and allied military vehicle platforms.

“We are pleased to continue supporting the Army as it brings high-performance technology into the compute architecture of its tactical ground vehicles,” said Mike Knowles, President and CEO of OSS. “We believe this award reflects the strength of our rugged compute and sensor processing platforms and our ability to address the Army’s evolving requirements. It also furthers our strategy of taking our Enterprise Class compute deeper into next-generation defense programs.”


**About One Stop Systems**
